title: Ops Status
description: At-a-glance status of the hypervisor fleet, for managers and wall screens.

panels.title: Fleet status
panels.description: Worst current condition across all hypervisors and VMs. Service impacted: a hypervisor is offline or an autostart VM is down. Attention: a VM or hypervisor is over a CPU/memory threshold or dropping packets.

panels.title: VMs down
panels.description: Autostart VMs that are not running.

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: VMs/hypervisors over CPU or memory thresholds, or dropping packets (see Warnings below).

panels.title: Sites
panels.description: Hypervisor sites, coloured by the worst hypervisor at each site: green healthy, red when a hypervisor is offline or has autostart VMs down. Locations come from sites.json on the collector.

panels.title: Hypervisor status  ·  click for Cockpit
panels.description: Hypervisor PCP agents as seen from the collector. Click a tile to open that hypervisor's Cockpit for troubleshooting.

panels.title: VM states
panels.description: All defined VMs across the fleet. Stopped = not running and not set to autostart.

panels.title: Busiest VMs (CPU, 15m avg)
panels.description: Top VMs fleet-wide by CPU as a % of their own vCPUs. Amber from 85%.

panels.title: Service-impacting issues
panels.description: Hypervisors offline and autostart VMs that are down. The value is the count.

B.text: ✕  VMs down that should be running (count)

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: VMs or hypervisors over threshold (VM CPU ≥ 85% over 15m, VM memory ≥ 90%, hypervisor CPU/memory ≥ 80%) or dropping packets. The value is the measured figure (% or packets/s).

B.text: ✕  VMs down that should be running (count)

panels.title: Hypervisor CPU (avg)
panels.description: Average non-idle CPU across hypervisors, last 6 hours. Amber from 80%, red from 90%.

panels.title: Hypervisor memory (avg)
panels.description: Average memory in use across hypervisors (excluding reclaimable cache). Amber from 80%, red from 90%.

panels.title: Network in
panels.description: Total received across hypervisors (physical NICs and the libvirt NAT bridge; SR-IOV VF traffic bypasses the host and isn't included).

panels.title: Network out
panels.description: Total sent across hypervisors (physical NICs and the libvirt NAT bridge; SR-IOV VF traffic bypasses the host and isn't included).

panels.title: Hypervisor network – last 6 hours
panels.description: Received above the line, sent below, per hypervisor.

panels.title: Top VM talkers (network, 15m avg)
panels.description: VMs moving the most traffic (virtio/tap interfaces), received and sent shown separately.
